Question: Assalaamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullaahi wa Barakaatuhu ! One Married muslim women working with us but she is not covered Face and Hand. She is calling me freqently 1 or 2 Time in a day for doubts in her Job bcos I am familier in it. Also note during that time I am in the situation to see her face for explanations, please confirm shall I go and help to her? And also she is calling our Team members(Married & unmarried(meture gents)) for dinner party to her home, during that that she is coming in front of us without complete hijab, please advise whether shall I go or not to her home ? Please advise what is sin for to seeing her face ? Please advise what is sin to her for coming in front of us without complete hijab ? Kindly remove the below sentense while publishing in Net, the below message for your information only. Please confirm before 14th September because I have again one Iftar party on 15 September, why I am asking urgently is that previous some dinner parties I was not attent for valid reason(duing that time I am in the path of Allah subhanavutallah Tabliqu), but she is told to all and asked me like why u r living seprate from team? Answer ID: 7891 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1829/270=B/1429) The face, hands and feet of a woman are not satr (coverable) but it is necessary to cover them if there is fear of fitna (mischief/evil). It is allowable if you keep your eyes lower, explain to her and help her in her work. You can also see her face when there are necessary questions and answers, but it also should be avoided unless necessary. If there are men in the party, you can go there to attend the party. You should lower your eyes as much as you can, but it is better to avoid accepting parties of women. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
